title: Hanasato Minori — Synonyms For Tasty〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you all very much for gathering here today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I would now like to begin this food review training session!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yay♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ahem, to explain... I, Minori Hanasato, did a really terrible job of describing what we ate during our shoot the other day!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I didn't think it was that bad.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. The way you're willing to recognize your shortcomings really is admirable.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still, I thought you said you were going to practice doing that while having food at home.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, I tried doing just that...
But it went so badly that my brother wouldn't stop laughing at me...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is why I want to work on this in secret and surprise him, Haruka and all the others!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I like your determination♪
We'll give you all the assistance we can.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So...!
I'd like to start by practicing with some sweets.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Cream puffs, eclairs, pudding...
Hehe. You brought quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I bought a lot of stuff because I want to get in a lot of training!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, please listen as I start by reviewing the cream puffs!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, of course♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Now, without further...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, shouldn't you say something about how they look before you start eating them?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But what's a positive thing you can say about its appearance?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... They're a nice golden brown?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, how they turned out seems pretty important.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What else...? How fluffy they are and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, good call♪
These cream puffs look very fluffy on the outside.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You could start with the outer pastry and comment about how they feel in your hand, no?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: How they feel in my hand?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. They look fluffy on the outside, but could be heavier than you expect because they're filled to the brim with custard.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Luka, you're a genius!
Lemme write that down.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, how does it feel in your hand...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-It feels...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Don't overthink it...
Just say whatever comes to mind.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, you're here to practice.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Right.
Then...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
It's so soft and delicate...
I feel that my fingers might puncture it if I grip it too tightly...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Which means it must be filled with quite a bit of custard. It also feels a little heavy as a result, no...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I think you're right!
And some people prefer ones with a thin, outer pastry.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Right!
It's the same with taiyaki! Some people prefer it thin!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, uhh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! You need to be careful when holding these! It feels so heavy with custard that it could burst out of the pastry at any moment!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: How does that sound?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That was great! I think that saved it♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, this seems like a better approach...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But saying that the custard is “heavy” may cause some confusion.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The custard's so heavy that...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
Some people might misinterpret that as the custard being too rich.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That means you just have to rephrase what you just said a little♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, then...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It feels so dense with custard that it could burst out of the pastry at any moment!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: All you did was switch out the word “heavy”.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
You're right...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Giving a good food review is much more difficult than I realized...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes...
She hasn't even taken a bite yet.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
This is all a part of her training!
We know you can do it, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks! I'll keep trying!
